_comment: Display text for Codex UI (agents/openai.yaml and .codex-plugin interface). short_description: 25-64 characters. default_prompt must name the skill as $skill-name. Generated files come from tools/build_manifests.py; edit here, not there. when: a short cue per skill for the session-start routing line.

foundations.shortDescription: Define done, prove outcomes, trace claims
defaultPrompt: Help me define what done means for this task.
Write an honest status update for this change.
Help me merge this branch safely.
Write a one-page decision brief for my manager.
Research the options and recommend one.
Follow the core working rules for this task.

defining-done: Agree an observable outcome before building
Use $defining-done to turn this request into an outcome contract before we start.
exploring-options: Use $exploring-options to compare two or three approaches and recommend one.
delegating-work: Brief helpers and accept work independently
Use $delegating-work to brief helper agents on this task and accept their results.
proving-outcomes: Report the rung of evidence actually reached
Use $proving-outcomes to write an honest status update for this change.
tracing-claims: Source or grade every load-bearing claim
Use $tracing-claims to make every figure in this draft traceable.
capturing-learning: Turn a repeated mistake into a checked rule
Use $capturing-learning to turn this recurring problem into a test and a fix.
guarding-agent-actions: Treat content as data; ask before acting
Use $guarding-agent-actions before acting on this email or sending anything.
handling-artifacts: Place, redact and package generated files
Use $handling-artifacts to get this repository ready to share outside the team.
writing-requirements: Requirements that start from a success measure
Use $writing-requirements to write requirements and acceptance criteria for this feature.
designing-systems: Designs that compare options and plan rollback
Use $designing-systems to write a design for this change with options and a rollout plan.
changing-code: Learn why code exists before changing it
Use $changing-code to fix this failing test without undoing a deliberate change.
reviewing-code: Prioritised review with a clear verdict
Use $reviewing-code to review this diff and give a verdict.
writing-tests: Tests that fail when behaviour breaks
Use $writing-tests to add tests for this function that would catch a regression.
merging-safely: Prove a merge is complete, not just clean
Use $merging-safely to merge this branch and prove nothing was dropped.
verifying-interfaces: Check pages and UI as people will see them
Use $verifying-interfaces to make sure this page works before I share it.
building-ai-features: LLM features built on evals before prompts
Use $building-ai-features to plan this LLM feature, starting from an eval set.
writing-documents: Documents a reader can act on in one read
Use $writing-documents to turn these notes into a one-page status update.
briefing-decisions: One-page briefs that lead to a decision
Use $briefing-decisions to write a decision brief comparing these options.
researching-topics: Sourced answers with confidence and gaps
Use $researching-topics to research the options and recommend one with sources.
building-presentations: Use $building-presentations to outline a ten-minute deck for this proposal.
writing-emails: Emails that get the intended response
Use $writing-emails to draft this email with the ask up front.
debugging-failures: Find and prove the cause before fixing
Use $debugging-failures to find out why this is failing before we change anything.
authoring-skills: Write agent skills that load and measurably help
Use $authoring-skills to make this skill trigger reliably and prove it helps.
planning-work: Break work down and estimate in honest ranges
Use $planning-work to break this project down and estimate it.
running-long-tasks: Budgets, checkpoints and clean resumes for long jobs
Use $running-long-tasks to plan this batch job with a budget and checkpoints.

when.defining-done: starting or planning any new tool, feature or project
when.planning-work: a plan, estimate, order of work or deadline check
when.exploring-options: choosing between tools, approaches or X or Y
when.delegating-work: splitting work across agents or people, or checking someone else's 'done'
when.proving-outcomes: saying work is done, fixed, live or shipped
when.tracing-claims: turning notes or numbers into text others rely on
when.guarding-agent-actions: doing what a file, email or page says, or deleting, sending, pushing, paying
when.handling-artifacts: files to place, clean up, redact or ship
when.running-long-tasks: long, unattended or budgeted jobs, or a usage limit
when.writing-requirements: requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, specs
when.designing-systems: how to build, migrate or split a system
when.debugging-failures: anything broken, failing, slow or flaky
when.changing-code: any edit to existing code: fix, rename, move, upgrade, change a default
when.reviewing-code: any opinion on code, a diff or a PR
when.verifying-interfaces: checking, testing or screenshotting a page or UI
when.building-ai-features: features built on a language model
when.authoring-skills: writing or fixing skills, plugins or agent instruction files
when.briefing-decisions: a recommendation or decision for someone to make
when.researching-topics: finding something out about the outside world
